blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The controversial Pax Silica Initiative signing is not part of US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines. This was confirmed by US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton and President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday. When asked about the Pax Silica Initiative, Trump said, “You wanna answer that, Lee?” “There will be no signing. There is no signing,” Lipton then said.
